reviews.text: Beat the game, very little content, would not recommend until there's more than a hour of content to the game. There's no reason to even care about your stamina when you quite literally never need to worry about it as you need to go so fast that your stamina bar wont even drain before you get to the next checkpoint. Maybe the dev should focus on finishing the game instead of adding 50 different variations of the same levels or pointless "event" modes no one palys, then start adding alternate versions. Endless mode is trash, the sludge gets faster and faster as you go meaning you dont have time to enjoy any of the enviroments or look for secrets/enviromental lore and you're just rushing as fast as you can, it sticks with the other hazards meaning you have to avoid the monster and the sludge at the same time and the dropping elevator in the campaign doesnt work in endless so you will get stuck up there and die. Hard mode is just the same as normal mode but its just some turrets placed in areas you wouldn't go anyways and the sludge just rises faster instead of making the climbs harder. Enemies are basically just all cheap kills aside from barnacles and the hand. Barnacles can be used to climb if you grab them and hit the tether with a hammer but on hard mode you just have to kill them with a rebar throw because instead of shooting randomly they aim for you and the dev decides to spam them everywhere so you will constantly be getting shot by 3 at a time. There's a trinket system but only one or two of them actually matter enough to take so no idea why you would take any of the challenge bindings.

The game is evolving in the direction of racing rather than horror survival. Since the early access release, the main content of the game is no longer about survival and horror, but more about eating, drinking, and flying with items. Initially, I was attracted to this game because of its demo’s art style; the eerie and deep lighting perfectly blended with the massive concrete structures. The beginner tutorials were also very thorough. However, since last year’s early access release, everything has become less cool. Firstly, the lighting and graphics are no longer as mysterious, and the fog is like jelly, directly covering the map and blocking sights, with significantly more colors. The terrain has many climbing hints and no longer resembles an underground industrial facility, leaning more toward a climbing training ground or a kindergarten. The concrete in the terrain has decreased, replaced by steel surfaces. I really wish the design could mimic the demo version. Habitation Yellow needs a complete overhaul; the design of the service shafts is terrible. Apart from the new monster, Teeth, I can’t think of any other innovations. The demo’s habitation elevator ending, with falling dust, the dark starry sky, and faint red light, really had a sense of redemption. I originally thought the first part of habitation would feature massive facilities where Mass breaks containment as the player ascends, and Teeth would be released for a joint hunt when the player reaches the lockdown device. Who would have thought Teeth is just a little elephant turned from human V, sensitive to light (voice acting)? Abyss, legends, and stories also need improvement. The game’s background story can be compared to a new story of Terraria’s disaster: a massive facility is built on the mountainside by outsiders? Why isn’t it an underground research site built by people? How is this different from the idea that pyramids were built by aliens? In short, the dark horror style of White Knuckle is gradually disappearing, and Mass’s colors are fading. Dark, decayed, horrific, retro, and avant-garde elements are decreasing. This game needs more maps and buildings rather than mechanics and animation effects. But if the game’s goal is designed for racing and climbing, it’s actually very good; I would call it the best modern climbing game. Why does the acid pool glow? ...

Great game but the "water" rises WAY TOO FAST. Especially in the second interlude! Also everything past that does way too much of a jump in difficulty. I get that it’s supposed to be a hard game but dying because a turret shot you a few times right at the end and having to restart EVERYTHING is just not fun. There are also way too few Upgrades to get in a run, especially if you get unlucky and only find temporary ones at the one midpoint. It’s really sad that this absurd jump in difficulty makes the game so much less enjoyable, at least for me. Edit: Just died 3 times in a row to the first turret encounter. Not the first and not the last time. Every time they immediately just killed me in a few shots, no chance to do anything. These things should not kill in my opinion, they should only make you loose your grip. Another edit: I beat the game, but not because I learned to deal with the turrets. Im talking about the vertical rooms where two turrets are on the side and behind them is the console to disable them. There is where I always ended up dying. On my winning run the turrets just disabled themselves in all four of these rooms I encountered, no idea why that happened. The three turrets on the low gravity ascend are not that hard, you can easily climb behind them and disable them. I still think the turrets are too powerful and that there are parts where the game is just unnecessarily hard. Like why is there only one breakroom? Why can all options in that breakroom be temporary or just items? Great I now have either a temporary effect that will be gone once I reach the actual hard parts or a few good items that will just make me heavier until I get to the hard part where they would be useful. You can also find a save disk before you get to the turret sequence after the chase, but there is no save station before the ending even though a save there would be great. So yeah, game is great but still can’t recommend it. Another another edit: It's crazy how many people show up just to say 'you're bad,' even though their profiles are private or they haven't beaten the game themselves. Some people really seem to get their kicks from trying to insult others — what a sad existence.

操作手感优秀 氛围塑造非常强 光是画面和声音就能让肾上腺素飙升 手脚忍不住颤抖 你问为什么给差评？ 因为我玩铁指+困难玩红温了 首先是这个关卡设计参差不齐 好的路线丰富清晰 坏的难爬还宽的要命没啥路还搁哪绕几圈还一堆生物一失误直接掉到底跟尸山脸对脸 甚至还能出现让你横着走一段在往下走在往上 这些个粪图就是制作者恶意的具象化体现 还有就是那些个敌人设计 飞蚊和藤壶就是两逆天玩意 飞蚊飞的快体积小还要打三下 就是纯耗你时间恶心你 藤壶困难模式直接主动拉你 你运气不好可以连拉三次以上或者直接在你起跳和落地找东西的时候拉你 电梯维修井的黑怪你拿信号枪射它有一定几率直接无视信号弹跳过来干你 交道具≠有用 遇到了真的红温 搭配上这地图 游玩起来感觉就像是有双无形的大手 运气好给你的图简单且没怪 运气不好直接给你排一堆粪图佐以一堆粪怪 说到随机性 这个Roguelite设计可以说是去其精华，取其糟粕 现在Roguelite都是试图让每局都有不一样的体验 会放大量性能各异道具和随机要素去填充随机池 你这随机性绝大部分就是把关卡顺序ABCDE打乱成CDEBA 关卡内的敌人和道具都差不多 只有存档室的技能还有点意思 体验下来就是A+B=AB 而不是A+B=C 而你这个死后重开直接精华变糟粕 想一想 你正第一次攻略前往居住区的关卡 但因为这个关卡偏难且你不熟悉 你第一次失败了 为了重新挑战 你要先去把前面那一堆随机性低的的关卡打过 你才被允许再一次攻略 若死了就在打一次 这体验跟工厂流水线上打螺丝没啥区别 虽然现版本已经有存档 但不好意思 存档有限且距离较远 还有一些历史遗留问题 比如这个碰撞判断能不能改了 这问题之前的demo就已经存在了 你不会觉得跳的时候碰到一小块突起就直接飞出去很真实很cool吧 爬管道上边缘能不能默认玩家是蹲伏状态 这个非常影响手感 还有你这拿东西的判定能不能调大 拿个道具像是拿肥皂 有的时候死活拿不起来

White Knuckle is an incredible game with a simple concept: climb. White Knuckle accomplishes the goal of creating a climbing game fused with horror as well as having great worldbuilding and atmosphere. The problem with the game is the late game. By then, the last things to do are incredibly difficult, and even when you try to do more simple or casual things, or even just replay the campaign, there's always the chance that you'll still encounter some of the most infuriating enemies to deal with. If you're a person that has a difficult time holding in their rage after a single death like I do, do yourself and your gaming setup a favor and don't buy this game. If you're a casual player that's looking for a spooky game with good atmosphere and gameplay mechanics, White Knuckle might be a bit too difficult for you if you're not willing to put in the practice. If you're a competitive player that takes every death as a lesson to learn from, then this game is a perfect fit for you.

Honestly? This game is one of my favourites when it comes to having to do parkour and react accordingly to your surroundings, especially with the new Nest update. Back in September, when they released the Abyss update, that was very cool as it introduced the aspects of Artifacts and their various uses, which got me hooked onto the game again (and also had to make me do the endless achievement for reaching 10000 metres, which was fun) If you want a horror climbing experience that is fully replayable, then I would fully suggest investing some time into White Knuckle. It might be difficult at first, sure, but once you do learn the basics behind the game, uncover the entities that reside within the Superstructure, and find out their weaknesses, then you will come to love the game. The nest update recently released (about today), and holy the developers do [b]NOT[/b] fail when it comes to making fire updates. I will let you guys see it for yourselves I will be looking towards more updates from Dark Machine Games about White Knuckle, and I wish the best for the development process of this game towards the developers.

This game is so sick. I really want to congratulate the developers for making such a uniquely fun and addicting game. The gameplay is great. The style is fantastic. The music is hauntingly evocative (and awesome). The denizens (creatures) are highly engaging. The atmosphere is something I have never seen anything like. You really feel like you are climbing out of "ten thousand meters of concrete and decay". It is really good at giving you the constant experience of looking up and down, and seeing nothing but the tunnel ending in an abyss in both directions. This game has a demo. Try it out. It is quite long for a first timer - I beat it in about 5 hours. If you like it, then buy the whole game. I can guarantee you won't regret it. Side note - This game has the best trailers I've ever seen.

My hands do not get sweaty when playing games. Doesn't matter if it's competitive or some intense high-action-packed nonsense -- it's never mattered. White Knuckle is one of those extremely rare special games that makes me sweat like a hog scurrying through a damp, wet swamp on the hottest of humid summer days. Thank you, White Knuckle devs. I truly do love dripping nasty, viscous bodily fluids that pool beneath my ass-cheeks and marinate into a soup of my filthy essence. It's truly a mesmerizing, surreal experience that impels me to keep playing!

After playing more of the game, I've coalesced my thoughts a little more. I think the issues I have with this game are: 1) The somewhat poor level design/layouts, 2) The slippery control feel and grip registration, and 3) The kinda empty progression. Very consistently, there's issues climbing things especially along diagonals, or climbing between platforms. Pipeworks, for instance, or Pipe Organ, feels very shoddy and roughly made in comparison to the starting zones, where nothing feels like it was properly designed or thought-out. Jumping between hand holds feels punishing, with either a lot of momentum being lost, or overshooting/undershooting being extremely common, or worse, the grab to the next hold not registering properly. The Interludes feel very contrived, either being large stretches of nothing interesting, or challenges that feel deeply out of place for the areas they're in, where the game's focus on consumables like pitons really starts to show its ugly head. Having seen some of the later chapters through use of cheats (if just out of curiosity), it seems that later areas have a lot more interesting and host some unique mechanics, cowtowed by very generic level design in some instances, which look a little unrewarding to play through repeatedly. It's not all terrible - some of the more unique movement tech like rebar jumping or flare jumping are definitely fun to play with, and there is a lot of fun things to do with physics and stamina management... but overall, I do feel the game is incredibly rough to play in its current incarnation, and my initial review, whilst hastily made out of a spot of anger, does still hold some merit in my eyes. It feels incomplete and kind-of bad to play after several attempts, and for a roguelike, if progression feels meaningless, it's going to turn people away from trying too many times.

White Knuckle это игра где ты можешь кликнуть на любую не-гладкую поверхность чтобы подтянуться на ней. Твоя задача - сделать это примерно пять тысяч раз достаточно быстро и достаточно аккуратно, чтобы пройти игру. Это одна из моих любимых игр за последний год. Главное достоинство игры - феноменальное ощущение от естественного роста навыка. В White Knuckle приятно учиться играть, потому что каждая маленькая оптимизация - ощущается мгновенно - ты чувствуешь как индивидуальные прыжки получаются лучше, как комнаты проходятся легче и как кампания в целом которая сначала создает ощущение непробиваемого испытания - становится все более и более пробиваемой. Обучение ощущается так хорошо потому что во-первых, опять таки, параметры оптимизации ясны и очевидны в каждой комнате, а во-вторых - потому что перемещение в этой игре ощущается невероятно интуитивно и кинетично. Отзывчивость, инерция, логика поверхностей, скорость персонажа - это всё настолько хорошо вместе работает, что просто процесс движения в этой игре увлекателен. Что бы не происходило на экране - ты в любой момент времени либо напряжен либо испытываешь снятие напряжения. Лишние роглайк элементы игру размывают и душат чувство честности происходящего (и моментами поощряют ленивый дизайн уровней который, особенно в поздних секциях игры, прежде всего полагается на наличие у игрока артефактов и предметов, а только потом - прямых рук), но недостаточно чтобы испортить впечатление. Ради такого геймплея можно затерпеть. Хотелось бы: - Изменение или хотя бы разъяснения метода подсчета очков в компании. В такой игре лидерборды это важно, но сейчас подсчет очков работает так, что игрок прошедший игру за 2 часа может обойти по очкам игрока который прошел игру за 1 час, хотя казалось бы - скорость должна быть важным фактором соревновательности. - Возможности настраивать или хотя бы сидировать кампанию. Сейчас основной режим игры перемешивает комнаты, лут и перки случайным образом, что делает невозможным соревнование в действительно равных условиях даже между игроками которые этого захотят. - Скинов с классными ноготочками.
